## Objective
- Build a complete, playable low-poly 3D incremental clicker about catching fish and buying cute otters that generate more fish.

## Requirements
- Make the game visually rich and satisfying, with minimal text.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Check screenshots as small JPEGs at no more than 1280px wide.

## Decisions
- Implemented the game as a single-page Three.js experience in `index.html`, with local save data and responsive desktop/mobile UI.
- Added a shiny net upgrade alongside otter helpers to add another progression path.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a low-poly pond diorama with a tappable fish, swimming fish, otters, and animated environmental details.
- Added fish currency, helper purchases, passive fish generation, click upgrades, save/load, and optional synthesized sound.
- Tested the game in Playwright, verified clicking earns fish and helper purchases work, and checked a mobile screenshot.
- `git diff --check` passes.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. If further changes are requested, continue from `index.html`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Tested with `python3 -m http.server 8000` and `playwright-cli`; final browser console check had no errors or warnings.

content.text:
Built the playable game in **`index.html`**. It includes a low-poly pond diorama, tappable fish, otter helpers that generate fish, a shiny-net click upgrade, escalating shop prices, local save data, and optional synthesized sound. The layout adapts to mobile.

Verified fish-catching and helper purchases in Playwright, checked desktop and mobile screenshots, and confirmed `git diff --check` passes. Assumed a single-page browser game with progress saved locally.
